h1: Custom Medium Pants for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom medium pants in bulk for your team. Perfect for uniforms, workwear, or promotional use at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Medium-sized pants are the most commonly requested size for corporate uniforms and promotional apparel. Whether you need sweatpants for a casual company retreat or scrub pants for your medical staff, ordering medium ensures a comfortable fit for the majority of your team. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery on cotton blends like the Gildan Heavy Blend Sweat Pants for a professional look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom medium pants for bulk orders, including sweatpants and scrub pants with logo decoration
